description: Recallium is a local, self-hosted universal AI memory system providing a persistent knowledge layer for developer tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Desktop). It eliminates "AI amnesia" by automatically capturing, clustering, and surfacing decisions and patterns across all projects. It uses the MCP for universal compatibility and ensures privacy
